description: This file implements the Lua engine integration for Redis, including functions for compiling, invoking, and managing Lua scripts, as well as engine initialization and registration.

classes.name: luaEngineCtx
classes.description: Context structure holding the Lua state for the engine.

classes.name: luaFunctionCtx
classes.description: Context structure holding a reference to a Lua function.

classes.name: loadCtx
classes.description: Context for loading Lua scripts, including timeout and start time.

classes.name: registerFunctionArgs
classes.description: Structure for arguments used when registering a Lua function.

methods.name: luaEngineLoadHook
methods.description: Hook function to cancel script load if timeout exceeds.

methods.name: luaEngineCreate
methods.description: Compiles Lua code and registers functions, returning a context or error.

methods.name: luaEngineCall
methods.description: Invokes a compiled Lua function with specified keys and arguments.

methods.name: luaEngineGetUsedMemoy
methods.description: Returns the memory used by the Lua engine.

methods.name: luaEngineFunctionMemoryOverhead
methods.description: Returns memory overhead for a compiled function.

methods.name: luaEngineMemoryOverhead
methods.description: Returns memory overhead for the Lua engine context.

methods.name: luaEngineFreeFunction
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a compiled Lua function.

methods.name: luaRegisterFunctionArgsInitialize
methods.description: Initializes registration arguments for a Lua function.

methods.name: luaRegisterFunctionArgsDispose
methods.description: Disposes of registration arguments and associated resources.

methods.name: luaRegisterFunctionReadFlags
methods.description: Reads function flags from Lua stack.

methods.name: luaRegisterFunctionReadNamedArgs
methods.description: Reads named arguments for function registration from Lua stack.

methods.name: luaRegisterFunctionReadPositionalArgs
methods.description: Reads positional arguments for function registration from Lua stack.

methods.name: luaRegisterFunction
methods.description: Registers a Lua function, callable from Redis.

methods.name: luaEngineInitEngine
methods.description: Initializes the Lua engine and registers it within the system.
